messages.subject: RE: {Suspected Spam} [distance-sampling] how to  reflect  the difference of groups quantity in distance sampling
parts: You have one row for each group detected.  That row will include a field for group size.  That will be 1 for a single animal, 10 for a group of size 10, and so on.  A line with multiple detections will have multiple rows in the data.
